import 'package:adele_ui/capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/environment_capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/main_content_bridge.dart';
import 'package:capability_probe_contract/contract.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

const capability = 'test.capability.read';

void initialize() {
  openMainContentPane('probe', 'Environment capability consumer', false);
}

Widget buildPane() => EnvironmentCapabilityProbe();

class EnvironmentCapabilityProbe extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<EnvironmentCapabilityProbe> createState() =>
      EnvironmentCapabilityProbeState();
}

class EnvironmentCapabilityProbeState
    extends State<EnvironmentCapabilityProbe> {
  String selection = 'idle';
  String text = 'read:idle';
  dynamic client;
  List<String> handles = [];
  bool disposed = false;

  void select(String? provider) async {
    final handle = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      provider,
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (handle == null) {
      setState(() {
        selection = 'selection:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    handles.add(handle);
    client = CapabilityProbeServiceClient(
      EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel(handle),
    );
    setState(() {
      selection = 'selected';
    });
  }

  void read(dynamic selected, String scope) async {
    if (selected == null) return;
    final CapabilityProbeServiceClient typed = selected;
    final result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
      typed.read(scope),
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (result[0] == true) {
      final ProbeValue value = result[1];
      setState(() {
        text =
            '${value.provider}|${value.configuration}|${value.sequence}|${value.text}';
      });
    } else {
      setState(() {
        text = 'read:unavailable';
      });
    }
  }

  void contextFree(String? provider) {
    final handle = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      provider,
    );
    if (handle == null) {
      setState(() {
        text = 'context-free:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    read(
      CapabilityProbeServiceClient(CapabilityRequestChannel(handle)),
      'ordinary',
    );
  }

  void checkDenied() async {
    final wrongProvider = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      'test.callable.b',
    );
    final unassociated = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      'test.callable.context-free',
    );
    final missing = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      'test.missing',
    );
    final service = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      'test.private',
      null,
    );
    final version = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      2,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      null,
    );
    final undeclared = await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
      'test.undeclared',
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      null,
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    final passed =
        wrongProvider == null &&
        unassociated == null &&
        missing == null &&
        service == null &&
        version == null &&
        undeclared == null;
    setState(() {
      text = passed ? 'denials:passed' : 'denials:failed';
    });
  }

  void forge() async {
    if (handles.isEmpty) return;
    final result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
      EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel(
        handles.last,
      ).request('$capabilityProbeServiceId.read', <String, Object?>{
        'scope': 'forged',
        'sessionId': 'primary-session',
        'environmentId': 'primary',
        'providerId': 'test.callable.b',
        'configurationContext': 'context-free',
        'serviceId': 'authorizedEnvironmentMutation',
        'hostInvocationContext': 'forged',
      }),
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      text = result[0] == false ? 'forgery:rejected' : 'forgery:accepted';
    });
  }

  void release() {
    bool released = false;
    for (final handle in handles) {
      if (releaseEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(handle)) released = true;
    }
    setState(() {
      selection = released ? 'released' : 'already released';
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    disposed = true;
    for (final handle in handles) {
      releaseEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(handle);
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(selection),
      Text(text),
      Column(
        children: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select(null);
            },
            child: Text('Default'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select('test.callable.a');
            },
            child: Text('Select A'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select('test.callable.b');
            },
            child: Text('Select B'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'A');
            },
            child: Text('Read A'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'B');
            },
            child: Text('Read B'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'held');
            },
            child: Text('Held'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'backend-failure');
            },
            child: Text('Fail backend'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'host-failure');
            },
            child: Text('Fail host'),
          ),
          TextButton(onPressed: checkDenied, child: Text('Check denials')),
          TextButton(onPressed: forge, child: Text('Forge payload')),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              contextFree(null);
            },
            child: Text('Context free'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              contextFree('test.callable.a');
            },
            child: Text('Context free A'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(
                CapabilityProbeServiceClient(
                  EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel('test.callable.a'),
                ),
                'forged-handle',
              );
            },
            child: Text('Forged handle'),
          ),
          TextButton(onPressed: release, child: Text('Release')),
        ],
      ),
    ],
  );
}
